name: Season Wheel
description: Pick a month, or a span of months, from the year laid out as a ring tinted by season, each month with its own small glyph.

props.name: range
props.description: Choose a span of months instead of one. The span runs clockwise and may cross the new year.

props.name: value
props.description: The month, 1 to 12, or with range the first and last month of the span (controlled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new month, or the new span.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Dims the ring and ignores input.
